body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 2. The target gains +1 Composure against pain until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: After the Action, the target may move 1 unit toward you; self moves freely.
Suppress one non-Critical Wound Condition's numerical penalties on the target until the start of your next turn.
